name: FCX vs NEM Pair Trade: Z-Score Mean Reversion
description: Pair trade analysis of FCX/NEM price ratio. Computes 60-day rolling z-score of the ratio, identifies extreme levels (±2.0σ), and measures forward ratio returns at 5d, 10d, and 20d horizons to assess mean-reversion potential.
source:
# FCX vs NEM Pair Trade — Z-Score Mean Reversion Analysis
# Price ratio + 60d rolling z-score, extreme events at ±2.0σ
# Forward ratio returns at 5d, 10d, 20d horizons

# --- Data ---
fcx = reference_stocks(ticker='FCX')()
nem = reference_stocks(ticker='NEM')()

# --- Price Ratio ---
ratio = fcx.c / nem.c

# --- Rolling Z-Score (60-day window) ---
z = zscore(window=60)(ratio)

# --- Extreme Z-Score Detection ---
# z > +2.0 → ratio is rich (short ratio = short FCX / long NEM)
# z < -2.0 → ratio is cheap (long ratio = long FCX / short NEM)
is_rich = is_valid(z) and z > 2.0
is_cheap = is_valid(z) and z < -2.0

# --- Forward Returns on the Ratio ---
# forward_returns gives % change of ratio over N days
fwd_5d = forward_returns(period=5)(ratio)
fwd_10d = forward_returns(period=10)(ratio)
fwd_20d = forward_returns(period=20)(ratio)

# Sparse forward returns at extreme events
# When cheap (z < -2): expect ratio to RISE → positive fwd return = win
cheap_fwd_5d = where(is_cheap, fwd_5d)
cheap_fwd_10d = where(is_cheap, fwd_10d)
cheap_fwd_20d = where(is_cheap, fwd_20d)

# When rich (z > +2): expect ratio to FALL → negative fwd return = win
# Flip sign so positive = profitable for the SHORT ratio trade
rich_fwd_5d = where(is_rich, -fwd_5d)
rich_fwd_10d = where(is_rich, -fwd_10d)
rich_fwd_20d = where(is_rich, -fwd_20d)

# --- Timestamps for charts ---
ts = index()

# ============================================================
# OUTPUT 1: Price Ratio + Z-Score Context
# ============================================================
xy_lines(
    title='FCX/NEM Price Ratio with 60d Z-Score',
    category='FCX vs NEM Pair Trade',
    order=1,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Price Ratio', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='60d Z-Score', color=Color.Slate, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=2.0, color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot, title='+2σ'),
        ReferenceLine(value=-2.0, color=Color.Green, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot, title='-2σ'),
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Fair Value')
    ]),
    y_axis_label='Z-Score'
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(z,))

# ============================================================
# OUTPUT 2: Event Markers — Extreme Z-Score Events
# ============================================================
# Direction label for event cards
dir_label = conditional_select(is_rich, 'Rich (Short Ratio)', is_cheap, 'Cheap (Long Ratio)', 'Neutral')
is_extreme = is_rich or is_cheap

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Extreme Z-Score',
        icon=Icon.AlertTriangleIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Z-Score', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='Direction', type=CardRenderType.BadgeFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.PrimaryBadge),
            ColumnSpec(title='FCX Price', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(title='Ratio', dp=3, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Footer),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(z, dir_label, fcx.c, ratio, is_extreme)

# ============================================================
# OUTPUT 3: Forward Returns — Does Mean Reversion Work?
# ============================================================
# Bars showing avg profitable return by horizon for cheap vs rich signals
xy_bars(
    mode=BarMode.series,
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    title='Avg Profitable Return by Horizon (Positive = Signal Works)',
    category='FCX vs NEM Pair Trade',
    order=2,
    color_by_value=True,
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    data_labels=True,
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='5d', color=Color.Blue, stack='Cheap (Long Ratio)'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='10d', color=Color.Blue, stack='Cheap (Long Ratio)'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='20d', color=Color.Blue, stack='Cheap (Long Ratio)'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='5d', color=Color.Slate, stack='Rich (Short Ratio)'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='10d', color=Color.Slate, stack='Rich (Short Ratio)'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='20d', color=Color.Slate, stack='Rich (Short Ratio)')
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Breakeven')
    ])
)(values=(cheap_fwd_5d, cheap_fwd_10d, cheap_fwd_20d, rich_fwd_5d, rich_fwd_10d, rich_fwd_20d))

# ============================================================
# OUTPUT 4: Summary Stats Table
# ============================================================
# Cheap signal stats
cheap_n = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Count)(cheap_fwd_5d)
cheap_hit_5d = 1.0 if (is_cheap and is_valid(fwd_5d) and fwd_5d > 0) else 0.0
cheap_hit_10d = 1.0 if (is_cheap and is_valid(fwd_10d) and fwd_10d > 0) else 0.0
cheap_hit_20d = 1.0 if (is_cheap and is_valid(fwd_20d) and fwd_20d > 0) else 0.0

# Rich signal stats (flipped: negative fwd return = win)
rich_n = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Count)(rich_fwd_5d)
rich_hit_5d = 1.0 if (is_rich and is_valid(fwd_5d) and fwd_5d < 0) else 0.0
rich_hit_10d = 1.0 if (is_rich and is_valid(fwd_10d) and fwd_10d < 0) else 0.0
rich_hit_20d = 1.0 if (is_rich and is_valid(fwd_20d) and fwd_20d < 0) else 0.0

summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Extreme Z-Score Signal Stats',
        row_size=4, col_size=4,
        row_headers=['Event Count', 'Hit Rate 5d', 'Hit Rate 10d', 'Hit Rate 20d'],
        col_headers=['Cheap (Long)', 'Rich (Short)', 'Median 5d Ret', 'Median 20d Ret'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    ),
    category='FCX vs NEM Pair Trade',
    order=0
)(cheap_n, rich_n, cheap_fwd_5d, cheap_fwd_20d, cheap_hit_5d, rich_hit_5d, cheap_fwd_10d, cheap_fwd_20d, cheap_hit_10d, rich_hit_10d, rich_fwd_5d, rich_fwd_20d, cheap_hit_20d, rich_hit_20d, rich_fwd_5d, rich_fwd_20d)
